final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark FROM per_order), first_group AS (SELECT p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - b.benchmark AS first_margin FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_fill > b.benchmark), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark FROM first_group) SELECT AVG(g.avg_fill) AS avg_fill_size, AVG(g.first_margin) AS avg_margin_over_first, AVG(g.avg_fill - s.benchmark) AS avg_margin_over_second FROM first_group AS g CROSS JOIN second_benchmark AS s WHERE g.avg_fill > s.benchmark
